headline: Bank of Canada Increases Benchmark Interest Rate to 2.5%
summary: The Bank of Canada raised its policy interest rate to 2.5%, citing pressure from elevated energy prices rather than domestic demand, with markets focusing on US tariff risks and an upcoming December decision.
why: The Bank of Canada manages monetary policy for Canada; benchmark interest rate changes directly influence commercial mortgage costs and the Canadian dollar.

impacts.name: Canadian 10-Year Benchmark Yield
impacts.why: The central bank's rate increase pushes sovereign yields higher.
